notableCells.director: task SHOWCASE3 repro (2026-08-29): the Studio device emulator PRESET -- Samsung Galaxy S22 Ultra -- not a bare viewport, glossy-mobile theme, the Playlist table demo. Three defects: (1) the chip row's own themed glow cropped by the demo screen painting over it (a hard dark band edge under the chips), (2) the header band's rows (auto Edit/Done toggle, header, hidden-column disclosure) reading as touching under the theme's own glow, (3) the hidden-column disclosure plate's leading-edge glow clipped flush at its own top.
notableCells.presetFacts: measured live, and this is the class of fact a bare-viewport headless sweep misses even at the SAME pixel dimensions: the preset's logical ViewportSize is 359x690 (the device picker's '772 x 360' label is a physical/orientation spec, not the logical solve size); GuiService:GetGuiInset().Y is 58 (the camera-cutout safe-area top inset, which the showcase chrome bar sits below). Reproducing this preset headlessly needs BOTH numbers set explicitly (viewportRect 359x690, coreSafeInsets.top derived from a 58 GuiInset), not just a 359x690 viewport with default insets.
